svg.title: ESP32-C5 transceiver
svg.desc: ESP32-C5 transceiver block diagram: receive chain left to right on top, shared LO in the middle, transmit chain right to left at the bottom; each block annotated with the registers that influence it.
svg.text: Direct conversion (zero IF, inferred), half duplex, one LO for both chains; 2.4 and 5 GHz, no divided LO
no register known; gain is one
inferred from BBTOP I and Q)
48 MHz on the C5-Zero; LO and
Analog I2C: block 0x67 (bbtop) through phy_chip_i2c_readReg()/phy_i2c_writeReg() under regi2c_enter_critical(); no other
analog block is touched. Capture setup: DUMP_MODE_REG [20:17] DUMP_SRC = 15, dump clocks forced (0x600a9c04, 0x600a0800 bit 2);
0x600a20b4, the C6's dump gate, is skipped: any access stalls 1.64 ms. The engine owns all of block 1 while it plays: no ring then.
